impact.meaning: A RISE in this series pushes mortgage rates UP. A fall pushes them DOWN.

chains.chain: QT / MBS runoff → ↑ MBS spread → ↑ 30Y mortgage rate
rationales: Fed MBS runoff removes the largest price-insensitive buyer from the market.
A wider spread raises the borrower rate even when Treasuries are unchanged.
